## What reader problem does this address?

Describe the change and resulting behavior. Keep private health information and browser data out of the pull request.

## Checks

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run package`
- [ ] Relevant browser checks, or a clear note below about what was not tested
- [ ] Sources, licenses, and review metadata checked if glossary content changed
- [ ] Privacy and permission changes documented if applicable

## Evidence and limits

Record the browsers actually checked, supporting public sources for data changes, and any remaining limits. A source check must not be described as clinical approval or comprehension testing.
